name: Diamonds
content:
# New MicroPatterns Script
# Display is 200x200

DEFINE PATTERN NAME="diamond" WIDTH=8 HEIGHT=8 DATA="0011110001100110110000111000000110000001110000110110011000111100"

VAR $CENTERX = $WIDTH / 2
VAR $CENTERY = $HEIGHT / 2
VAR $NegativeCENTERX = -1 * $WIDTH / 2
VAR $NegativeCENTERY = -1 * $HEIGHT / 2
VAR $SECONDPLUSONE = $SECOND + 1
VAR $SIZE = 3
VAR $biggerWidth = $width * 4

COLOR NAME=BLACK
FILL NAME="diamond"

SCALE FACTOR=10
FILL_RECT X=0 Y=0 WIDTH=$WIDTH HEIGHT=$HEIGHT

TRANSLATE DX=$CENTERX  DY=$CENTERY
VAR $counter10times = 36 * $counter

REPEAT COUNT=5
  LET $size = $size * 3
  SCALE FACTOR=$size
  ROTATE DEGREES=$counter10times
  TRANSLATE DX=-90  DY=-90
  FILL_RECT X=0 Y=0 WIDTH=200 HEIGHT=200
ENDREPEAT
